x2_definition.name: X2 = the preregistered ablation arm 'weights_only', promoted to candidate
x2_definition.why_allowed: Protocol rule 6 permits up to 3 experiments. The base preregistration reserved X2/X3 for defect fixes; this amendment replaces that self-imposed restriction with an exploratory-then-confirmatory design: the arm was fully specified before any result (band-weighted model, global descending placement), it was selected on seed 20 only, and it must now pass every gate on two holdout draws nobody has observed.
x2_definition.surface: the same band-weighted nested hide-and-recover regressor as X1 (weights w = n / (7 n_band) over the 7 distance-to-visible bands)
x2_definition.placement: gems79.placement.place: global descending surface, 3 px Euclidean spacing, budget 37654 (holdout: scaled by region area); allowed = footprint & not catalogue (identical to the holdout arm; no distance quota)
x2_definition.final_map: model trained on nested hides of the full catalogue (seed 794000), geometry from the full catalogue, surface on footprint & not catalogue, 37654 binary dots, zeros elsewhere (all finite)

x2_promotion_gate: G1 all canaries <= 0.90 on seeds 30 and 40
G2 standard holdout: weights_only > h33_foldfair_control on seeds 30 AND 40 with paired 95% CI of the difference above 0 on both
G3 far-field sub-holdout: weights_only point estimate >= h33_foldfair_control on seeds 30 AND 40
G4 weights_only vs uniform_control paired 95% CI above 0 on seeds 30 and 40
G5 surface uniqueness BEFORE placement (chance-corrected-v4): full-surface Spearman <= 0.90; provisional global top-37654 cells chance-corrected overlap <= 0.70
G6 final dots uniqueness (chance-corrected-v4), complete scan including the 215 rasters recovered by the repaired delta scanner (IR-79-69) and this repository's own archived negatives
